text: Kaito Brennan designed the roof of Ninefold Stadium, officials confirmed Tuesday as the long-delayed sports complex opened for public tours in Brackenport. City engineer Mara Venn said the structure’s sweeping steel lattice was Brennan’s concept from the start and remained unchanged through final construction. The roof spans 180 meters and uses translucent panels to reduce daytime lighting costs by an estimated 22 percent, according to the Harbour Works Department. Contractors finished the final section on Monday after a two-week weather delay. Brennan, a coastal architect known for civic venues, was selected in 2022 after a regional design competition. “It was his vision, and it gave the stadium its identity,” Venn said.
